title: Exact small values for Erdős problem #757: Sidon subsets of (4,5)-sets
description: Explicit (4,5)-sets of n integers whose largest Sidon subset has size f(n), for n = 6–15, 17, 19, 21, matching the Henning–Yeo lower bound of Ma and Tang, so f(n) is determined for these n. Includes an exact brute-force checker. Search code and checker developed with Claude Code (Anthropic) under the direction of the author.
